brief.text: Berkshire Hathaway’s $136.4 million transaction in Lennar Corp (LEN) dwarfs all other activity, standing as the single largest purchase in the dataset. In cluster buys, Bank Bradesco (BBD) logged an extraordinary 21 insiders committing a total of $29.0 million, compared to the next largest group of 6 insiders at Dick’S Sporting Goods (DKS) totaling $5.1 million. Sector-wise, real estate investment trusts and closed-end funds drew recurrent interest, highlighted by cluster transactions in Agree Realty (ADC) at $4.1 million and General American Investors (GAM) at $672,290.
